prompt: A researcher randomly assigns volunteers with headaches to receive a new pill or an identical-looking inactive pill, then compares pain ratings. Which statement best identifies the design element or flaw?

options.text: The inactive pill is a placebo control, helping separate the pill effect from expectation or natural improvement.
The study is observational because pain ratings are observed after treatment.

misconception_source.label: Treated an observational study as an experiment

sources.note: observational studies do not impose treatments; experiments do

options.text: The main flaw is confounding because one group receives an inactive pill.

misconception_source.label: Confused confounding with a lurking variable or unrelated association

sources.note: experimental and observational designs require identifying confounding and other design flaws

options.text: The inactive pill is the randomization method because it decides which group each person joins.

misconception_source.label: Confused control, blinding, placebo, and randomization

sources.note: randomization, control, placebo, and blinding serve different roles in experimental design
